page_title: WOL 2-1 MCI | Wolves v Manchester City 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+7' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Jack Grealish (Manchester City) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

90+5' Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fabio Silva (Wolves) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Wolves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' The attendance for today's match is 31415.
86' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Matheus Cunha is replaced by Fabio Silva (Wolves).
86' The substitution is prepared. Jonny (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hee-Chan Hwang.
85' An attempted cross from Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) is cleared.

84' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Jose Sa has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
83' This is a yellow card! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
83' Jose Sa (Wolves) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
83' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) picks up an injury.
80' It is time for a substitution. Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is on for Nathan Ake.

79' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Manchester City are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
78' Matt Doherty (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement. Manchester City have a free kick.
76' Jeremy Doku has a look up and finds Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
76' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
75' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
74' Gary O'Neil is forced to make a change. Rayan Ait Nouri is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
73' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
72' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
67' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Boubacar Traore (Wolves) replaces Joao Gomes.
66' 2 - 1 Goal! Matheus Cunha puts the ball on a plate for Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:1.
66' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
66' Phil Foden (Manchester City) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
66' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
66' It's time for a substitution. Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) comes on in place of Mateo Kovacic.
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City). The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
63' The referee is firm and issues Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) a deserved yellow card.
62' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
60' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is caught offside!
59' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
58' 1 - 1 Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight into the top left corner. A technically perfect strike!
57' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Pedro Neto (Wolves) is given a yellow card.
57' Referee Craig Pawson sees the trip by Joao Gomes (Wolves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Manchester City have a free kick from a promising distance.
56' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
56' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

55' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Jose Sa was alert and the score remains the same.
52' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
51' A pass from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is intercepted by Ederson and the move breaks down.
50' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
49' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Wolves are awarded the free kick.
48' The resulting corner, taken by Phil Foden (Manchester City), comes to nothing.

48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester City, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
47' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to Manchester City, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Pep Guardiola gives a chance to Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) and Matheus Nunes is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' The free kick into the box finds Ruben Dias (Manchester City), who directs his header into the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping.
45+3' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick is awarded to Manchester City.
45+3' A great run by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.

45+1' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a low shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the middle of the goal, but it lacks power and Jose Sa pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Pedro Neto (Wolves) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
44' Craig Dawson (Wolves) commits a foul and Craig Pawson immediately signals a free kick. Manchester City win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
43' Pedro Neto (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
42' Looks like Pedro Neto (Wolves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

42' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Craig Pawson with no other option than to blow for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolves.
41' The ball rebounds out to Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
39' Mario Lemina (Wolves) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
39' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
39' Max Kilman (Wolves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul. Manchester City are awarded a free kick.
38' Pedro Neto (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
37' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
35' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
33' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) brings an opponent down and Craig Pawson interrupts the game. Wolves get a free kick.
31' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

30' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Jose Sa makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
28' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
27' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.

27' Joao Gomes (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement. Manchester City earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
24' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
24' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

22' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
19' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Craig Pawson signals. It's a free kick to Manchester City, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
17' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
16' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
13' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Ruben Dias (Manchester City), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
12' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
9' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) and blew his whistle. Wolves will take a free kick near the side line.
7' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

7' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester City, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' A player from Wolves commits a rough challenge. Craig Pawson blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Manchester City.
6' Erling Haaland receives a sweet pass inside the box from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
3' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
1' The first half has started.
Wolves will kick the game off.
Craig Pawson was nominated as the referee for this game.
